human_name: Y chromosome palindrome P2 (AZFc, CDY/RBMY adjacent to P1)

GRCh38.note: Approximate — between P3 and P1 in AZFc per Skaletsky 2003. GRCh38 P1-P3 discordant with T2T-Y per Rhie 2023.

CHM13.note: T2T-CHM13 v2.0/Y v1 — P2-left-arm 23897358-24035399 (138041 bp), P2-right-arm 24037534-24167130 (129596 bp), spacer 24035399-24037534 (~2.1 kb). Source: chm13v2.0Y_inverted_repeats_v1.bed (marbl). Central part nearly identical to P1.

architecture_note: Central part nearly identical to adjacent P1 palindrome (Skaletsky 2003). Contributes to ampliconic mosaicism that drives AZFc deletions via P1-P2-P3 cross-palindrome NAHR.

diagnostic_features.p1_p2_p3_relationship: Skaletsky 2003 reports >80% of P1 sequence is shared with P2 and P3; cross-palindrome NAHR is documented (Repping 2002)

primary.note: Same as P1 — 99.97% identity requires spacer/flanking anchoring.

fallback_chain.name: spacer_anchor
fallback_chain.trigger: primary returns ambiguous chains across both arms
fallback_chain.rationale: P2 spacer is tiny (~2 kb) — most reads will not span it; need to use boundary anchors

fallback_chain.name: flanking_anchor
fallback_chain.rationale: anchor to P3-P2 or P2-P1 boundary unique sequence

primary_sources.note: Skaletsky H et al., Nature. Table 3: P2 arm 122 kb, spacer 2.1 kb, identity 99.97%, total 246 kb (refined to 138 kb arms in T2T-Y).
Rozen S et al., Nature. Abundant gene conversion between arms of palindromes — provides arm-to-arm identity context.
Repping S et al., AJHG — P5/proximal-P1 NAHR also involves P2-P3 amplicon mosaic
Rhie A et al., Nature. T2T-Y precise coordinates for P2.
